title: Certifications
description: Voluntary certifications the brand states for this product (private schemes, not legal requirements). The node passes them on as stated; checking a licence is up to the reader.

scheme.description: Open vocabulary; recommended: gots, ocs, grs, rcs, oeko_tex_standard_100, oeko_tex_made_in_green, bluesign, fsc, lwg, rws, rds.

licence_number.description: The licence, certificate or label number as issued by the scheme.

scope.description: product: the finished product is certified; material: a material in it is (the product itself is not).
